title: Algebraic residue enlargement in an Artinian local algebra
statement: Let $k$ be a field of characteristic $p>0$, let $B$ be an Artinian local $k$-algebra, and let $A_0\subseteq B$ be a local admissible $k$-subalgebra [def-weil-pbc-popescu-admissible-subalgebra] relative to $\mathfrak m_B$. Let $x\in B$ be a unit. Assume inclusion $A_0\to B$ is local. Write $F_0=A_0/\mathfrak m_{A_0}$ and $K=B/\mathfrak m_B$. Give $K$ an $F_0$-algebra structure compatible with $k\to F_0\to K$ and such that the image of the residue of every $a_0\in A_0$ is its residue in $B$. Assume $\alpha=\operatorname{res}_B(x)$ is algebraic over $F_0$ [def-weil-algebraic-element]. There exist a local admissible $k$-subalgebra $A\subseteq B$ containing $A_0$, an integer $Q\geq1$, and $a\in A$ such that $\operatorname{res}_B(a)=\operatorname{res}_B(x^Q)$. Moreover $F=A/\mathfrak m_A$ admits an $F_0$-algebra structure with compatible $k$-scalar tower, satisfying $\operatorname{res}_A(a_0)=\operatorname{res}_{A_0}(a_0)$ after scalar extension for every $a_0$, and $F/F_0$ is formally étale.

source.place: Tags 07FH and 07FI; geometric enlargement in steps 1, 3–10 of lem-weil-pbc-popescu-denominator-basis-enlargement, before Frobenius capture and numerator clearing. The source is also available at https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/07FI and https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/07FH.

proof.text: The ambient B and A₀ are Artinian local. Their maximal ideals are nilpotent; admissibility supplies essential finite type and flatness of A₀ into B, and equality of the extended maximal ideal with m_B. The specified residue algebra identifies F₀ as a subfield of K. The residue of the unit x is nonzero. F₀ is essentially of finite type over k as a quotient of A₀.
Apply the separable-first purely inseparable decomposition to the simple algebraic extension F₀(α). A positive p-power Q has β=α^Q separable over F₀.

*Case S: the field $F_1=F_0(\beta)$ (as in 07FI, case algebraic).* $\alpha$ is algebraic over $F_0$, so $F_0(\alpha)/F_0$ is an algebraic extension and by [lem-weil-pbc-separable-first-purely-inseparable] there is $Q=p^e$ ($e\ge0$) with $\beta:=\alpha^Q$ separable over $F_0$ [def-weil-pbc-separable-algebraic-extension]; $\beta\neq0$. Let $F_1=F_0(\beta)\subseteq K$; it is generated by $\beta$, so $F_1\cong F_0[T]/(\bar g)$, $\bar g$ the minimal polynomial of $\beta$, is finite over $F_0$, and as the elements of $F_1$ separable over $F_0$ form a subfield containing $F_0$ and $\beta$ [lem-weil-pbc-separable-first-purely-inseparable], $F_1/F_0$ is finite and separable algebraic. Hence $F_1$ is a finite etale $F_0$-algebra, by Algebra.Etale.of_finite_of_isSeparable [lem-weil-pbc-finite-separable-extension-etale]. $A_0$ and $\bar\Lambda$ are local rings whose only prime is the maximal ideal [lem-weil-pbc-artinian-local-unique-prime], have nilpotent maximal ideals and hence are henselian [lem-weil-pbc-henselian-of-nil-maximal-ideal]. By the essential surjectivity in [lem-weil-pbc-henselian-finite-etale-equivalence] for $A_0$ and the finite etale $F_0$-algebra $F_1$ there is a finite etale $A_0$-algebra $D'$ with an $F_0$-algebra isomorphism $D'/\mathfrak m_{A_0}D'\cong F_1$. $D'$ is finite over $A_0$, hence Noetherian [lem-weil-pbc-finite-type-algebra-noetherian]; $\mathfrak m_{A_0}D'$ is nilpotent with quotient a field, so it is the maximal ideal of the local ring $D'$, which is Artinian [lem-weil-pbc-noetherian-local-quotient-artinian-local] with residue field $F_1$, and $A_0\to D'$ is local.

*Case S: a factorization $A_0\to D'\to\bar\Lambda$ (Stacks: 'since $\bar\Lambda$ is henselian and $F(\alpha^q)$ is contained in its residue field we can find a factorization').* Let $\rho:D'\to F_1\subseteq K$ be the residue map composed with the isomorphism above; on $A_0$ it is the residue map $A_0\to F_0\subseteq K$. Let $C=D'\otimes_{A_0}\bar\Lambda$; $\bar\Lambda\to C$, $x\mapsto1\otimes x$, is etale [lem-weil-pbc-etale-ring-base-change]. The maps $\rho$ and $x\mapsto\hat x$ are ring maps $D'\to K$, $\bar\Lambda\to K$ agreeing on $A_0$, so they define a ring map $\chi:C\to K$, $d\otimes x\mapsto\rho(d)\hat x$, surjective (already on $1\otimes\bar\Lambda$). Its kernel $\mathfrak q'$ is a prime of $C$ lying over $\bar{\mathfrak m}$, and $K=\bar\Lambda/\bar{\mathfrak m}\to C/\mathfrak q'\cong K$ is the identity, an isomorphism. By [lem-weil-pbc-henselian-etale-retraction] ($\bar\Lambda$ henselian by the preceding construction) there is a $\bar\Lambda$-algebra map $\sigma:C\to\bar\Lambda$ with $\sigma^{-1}(\bar{\mathfrak m})=\mathfrak q'$. Put $\psi'(d)=\sigma(d\otimes1)$. For $a\in A_0$, $\psi'(a)=\sigma(1\otimes a)=a$, so $\psi'$ restricts to the inclusion on $A_0$. Reducing $\sigma$ modulo $\bar{\mathfrak m}$ gives a $K$-algebra map $C/\mathfrak q'\to K$, which is the inverse of the isomorphism $K\to C/\mathfrak q'$; hence $\widehat{\psi'(d)}=\chi(d\otimes1)=\rho(d)$ for $d\in D'$. So $\psi'$ is local ($\psi'^{-1}(\bar{\mathfrak m})$ is a prime of $D'$, i.e. $\mathfrak m_{A_0}D'$, by [lem-weil-pbc-artinian-local-unique-prime]) and induces on residue fields the inclusion $F_1\subseteq K$.

*Case S: $A=\psi'(D')$ is admissible and a residue inverse.* As in the transcendental case, [lem-weil-pbc-criterion-flatness-fibre-noetherian] for $A_0\to D'\to\bar\Lambda$ and $M=\bar\Lambda$ ($M/\mathfrak m_{A_0}M$ is a vector space over the field $D'/\mathfrak m_{A_0}D'\cong F_1$, hence flat [def-weil-pbc-flat-ring-map]; $M$ flat over $A_0$) shows that $\psi'$ is flat; it is local, hence faithfully flat [lem-weil-pbc-flat-local-hom-faithfully-flat] and injective [lem-weil-pbc-faithfully-flat-ideal-contraction]. $A=\psi'(D')\cong D'$ is a $k$-subalgebra of $\bar\Lambda$ containing $A_0$, Artinian local, flat into $\bar\Lambda$, with $\mathfrak m_A\bar\Lambda=\mathfrak m_{A_0}\bar\Lambda=\bar{\mathfrak m}$ and residue field $F=F_1=F_0(\beta)\subseteq K$, finitely generated over $k$; as in the transcendental case, $k\to F$ is essentially of finite type [def-weil-pbc-essentially-finite-type-algebra] [def-weil-pbc-finite-type-algebra] and so is $k\to A$ [lem-weil-pbc-artinian-local-essentially-finite-type-residue]. So $A$ is admissible and $A_0\subseteq A$. Lift β through the surjection A → F to a. The residue embedding F → K then gives residue_B(a)=residue_B(x^Q). Finite separability makes F/F₀ formally étale. Quotient functoriality supplies the scalar tower and residue compatibility.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_popescu_algebraic_residue_enlargement
    (k : Type u) (B : Type v) [Field k] [CommRing B] [Algebra k B]
    [IsArtinianRing B] [IsLocalRing B]
    (p : ℕ) [CharP k p] (hp : 0 < p)
    (A₀ : Subalgebra k B) [IsLocalRing A₀]
    (hA₀ : A₀.IsPopescuAdmissible (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal B))
    (x : B) (hx : IsUnit x)
    [IsLocalHom A₀.val]
    [Algebra (IsLocalRing.ResidueField A₀) (IsLocalRing.ResidueField B)]
    [IsScalarTower k (IsLocalRing.ResidueField A₀) (IsLocalRing.ResidueField B)]
    (hmap : ∀ a₀ : A₀, algebraMap (IsLocalRing.ResidueField A₀)
      (IsLocalRing.ResidueField B) (IsLocalRing.residue A₀ a₀) =
        IsLocalRing.residue B (a₀ : B))
    (hα : IsAlgebraic (IsLocalRing.ResidueField A₀) (IsLocalRing.residue B x)) :
    ∃ (A : Subalgebra k B) (_ : IsLocalRing A), ∃ hle : A₀ ≤ A,
      A.IsPopescuAdmissible (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal B) ∧
      ∃ (Q : ℕ) (_ : 1 ≤ Q) (a : A),
        IsLocalRing.residue B (a : B) = IsLocalRing.residue B (x ^ Q) ∧
        ∃ (alg : Algebra (IsLocalRing.ResidueField A₀) (IsLocalRing.ResidueField A)),
          letI := alg
          IsScalarTower k (IsLocalRing.ResidueField A₀) (IsLocalRing.ResidueField A) ∧
          (∀ a₀ : A₀, algebraMap (IsLocalRing.ResidueField A₀)
            (IsLocalRing.ResidueField A) (IsLocalRing.residue A₀ a₀) =
              IsLocalRing.residue A (Subalgebra.inclusion hle a₀)) ∧
          Algebra.FormallyEtale (IsLocalRing.ResidueField A₀)
            (IsLocalRing.ResidueField A)
